title: Buy something (online)
start_push: Just check the price. That's all for now.

steps.text: Find the price and read it
Check you have enough money for this
Ask yourself if you need this right now
Look at one other option, then stop looking
tips: Buying your usual item, or already decided (it's on your list)? You can skip this step
Same item in different sizes? The shelf tag or listing may show price per ounce. Lower is cheaper. You can take a photo and ask

steps.text: Decide: buy it, or leave it for now
tips: Can't decide? You can choose your usual, or leave it for now and come back later

substeps.text: Choose pickup only if you already know how to get there. Not sure? Choose delivery
Delivery: check you'll be home when it arrives
Pickup: check the store is open when it's ready
Choose when: now, or a time later

tips: Priority usually costs more. Standard is fine if you're not in a hurry
Delivery: you can choose 'Leave at door' in the delivery options
Pickup: say your name or order number at the store
Not sure if you can get there? Choose delivery, or ask your support person

steps.text: Check the total before you pay

substeps.text: Look for delivery and service fees
Look at the tip (delivery only). Choose an amount you're OK with
Check the total matches what you expected

tips: Have a promo code? Enter it here. Don't spend long searching for one

substeps.text: Check the apartment or unit number
Check the payment (your saved card or a gift card)

tips: Page stuck or showing an error? Don't press Place Order again. Check your orders or email first, so you don't pay twice
Gift card doesn't cover it all? You'll need another card for the rest
No card saved yet? That's a separate task: 'Add a card'. You can do it on your own or with your support person

substeps.text: Take a screenshot or star the email
